title: Classify documents and summarize invoices
query: Process the mixed JPG and PDF document files in /app/documents/. Classify each document as either 'invoice' or 'other' based on document content. Move all invoices to /app/invoices/ and all other documents to /app/other/. Only for invoices, extract total_amount including tax by looking for terms such as "Total", "Amount Due", or "Grand Total"; extract vat_amount by looking for terms such as "VAT", "Tax", or "GST"; if VAT is not present, set vat_amount to 0 or an empty string. If both "Total" and "Amount Due" are present with different values, use only the "Total" amount. Create /app/invoices/summary.csv with exactly the columns filename, total_amount, vat_amount, and add a final row with filename 'total' containing the calculated total of the total_amount and vat_amount columns from the individual invoices. Ensure the original /app/documents/ directory is empty after processing, with all files moved.
review_flags: The task permits vat_amount to be either 0 or an empty string when VAT is not present, so the required representation is ambiguous.
The final 'total' row wording could be read as summing each of the total_amount and vat_amount columns separately; confirm whether those two column totals are intended.
